name: speedboat pilot
about: Read by scripts/blender/pilot/*.py and scripts/blender/pilot/checkPilotGlb.mjs. Numbers the hull JSON / parts manifest do not carry, each with its source. docs/speedboat/pilot-log.md explains every decision.

assets.about: CC0 MakeHuman asset packs installed in MPFB's user data dir (pilot-log.md §Installs). The build verifies each file's sha256 and fails loud when one is missing or changed.

skinB.pack: makehuman_system_assets (mhmat header: explicitly released as CC0 in september 2020)

skinC.pack: makehuman_system_assets (mhmat header: explicitly released as CC0 in september 2020)

variants.about: Same topology, same UV layout, same skeleton. Shape = glTF morph target on every skinned mesh; skin = KHR_materials_variants swapping the skin albedo; hair = one of three card sets (Hair_<style>) + hair tint uniform. MakeHuman macros: age 0.5 = 25 y, 1.0 = 90 y.

npc_b.label: rival, woman, early 40s, dark skin, hair pulled back in a knot

npc_c.label: veteran, man, around 60, grey beard stubble, clipped grey buzz cut

body.heightSource: STYLE-SPEC §8: adult, 1.78 m, average build. Every variant is solved to the same stature so one skeleton serves all three
body.jointDeltaNote: variants keep one bone hierarchy; their own rest joint positions ship in root extras (variantJointHeads) and the runtime re-binds a variant clone to them, so a 4 cm shorter arm still bends at its own elbow

seat.about: Pilot frame = seat socket frame. Origin = the hull JSON seat station (renderOnly.cockpit.seats[0]: x, zFromTransom) at the top of the seat pan (well sole + 0.62). +Z = bow, +Y = up, metres. The runtime parents the pilot root to that point in the boat body frame: (seat.x, deckY - cockpitWell.soleBelowSheer + 0.62, zFromTransom - lcgFromTransom). v1 put the origin at the pan's front edge; scripts/blender/parts/seat.py builds the pan centred on the station (front edge at z +0.19), so v2 follows the parts build.
seat.sources: scripts/blender/parts/seat.py (pan 0.44 x 0.34 centred 0.02 ahead of the station, rotated -8 deg; bucket back 0.16 behind the station raked 12 deg) and STYLE-SPEC par.2 (pan 0.62 above the sole)

helm.about: REAL parts sockets (pilot frame, three.js axes). Read from the parts build (commit b092f2e scripts/blender/parts/*, GLB assets/models/speedboat_pipeline_test.glb built against the current deepV12.hull.json: partsAnchors seatZ 0.234, deckY 0.82): Helm_LOD0 extras pivot/axis, Throttle_LOD0 extras pivot/axis/idleDeg/fullDeg, minus the seat socket (0, 0.69004, 0.234). Rim radius/tube and the throttle handle offset exist only in helm.py / throttle.py code (no extras), footrest in seat.py. The dash-cable jack has NO parts socket (still assumed).
helm.gripNote: hands at ten-to-two (52 deg from 12 o'clock): the helm's three spokes sit at 12, 4 and 8 o'clock (helm.py), and the upper rim is 8 cm higher than 9-and-3 on this low wheel

head_geo.about: carries every head-weighted vertex (face, hair, eyes, goggles, headset): the cockpit camera collapses THIS bone, so head and cam_eye keep their transform

cam_eye.about: cockpit camera: between the eyes, forwardM ahead of the eye midpoint so a near plane <= nearMaxM clears the goggle lenses; node -Z = view direction, +Y = up (glTF camera convention)

lod.budgetNote: v2 target: pilot LOD0 <= 18k worst variant (hero, swept hair) against the hero boat's 120k LOD0 total (hull ~40k + parts 63.6k). The parts manifest line is 14k: the coordinator rebalances ~4k from hull/parts or accepts ~122k. pilot-log.md §Budget has the per-piece split.

seated_base.about: reference pose for every additive clip

goggles_up.about: menus and results: goggles pushed up on the forehead

M_Pilot.surface: suit, vest, harness, gloves, boots, headset, goggle frame + strap, air bottle, cable

M_PilotSkin.surface: head, neck, eyes (hero albedo/normal 2048, NPC albedo variants 1024)

M_PilotLens.surface: goggle lenses (tinted clearcoat, samples the M_Pilot normal atlas)

hair.about: one Hair_<style>_LOD0/1 node per style; a variant draws the style named by variants.<v>.hair (pilot-log.md §Hair)
